title: Your fall weekend by the river

voice.instructions: Read the supplied script verbatim in a warm, casual, conversational brand voice. Sound clear and lightly enthusiastic. Deliver the opening directly as a helpful heads-up, not an alarm. Use natural contractions and brief breaths between ideas. Eddy sounds like Eddie; Pulltite sounds like pull tight; Recreation.gov is recreation dot gov. No announcer voice, fake personal testimonial, added words, music or sound effects.

scenes.text: Camping at Pulltite? You need a reservation.
